purpose: Six logo concepts for an online board-game platform.

concepts.name: The L Tile
concepts.description: A compact monogram built from board-game tiles.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original logo exploration for Ludora, a friendly modern online board-game platform supporting many types of tabletop games. Create ONE finished original logo concept. Scene/backdrop: completely plain solid warm ivory #f7f5f0, no texture. Style/medium: polished flat vector-like brand design with crisp edges, strong silhouette, balanced negative space, production-minded simplicity. Composition: wide landscape presentation, one centered horizontal emblem-and-wordmark lockup occupying roughly 70% of canvas width with generous margins. Color palette from the actual app: main deep petroleum teal #0f5961, restrained ochre-gold accent #d99a32, ivory #f7f5f0, optional ink #17272d. Typography must be highly legible and customized. Text verbatim: "Ludora" (capital L followed by lowercase u d o r a). Render this word exactly once; no tagline or other text. Constraints: few broad flat shapes, no hairline details, recognizable at small app-icon size; original design only. Avoid gradients, shadows, 3D, embossing, mockup objects, photographic scenes, detailed illustrations, video-game controllers, esports crests, casino cues, chess-specific branding, watermarks, concept numbers, presentation labels or extra decorative graphics.
Concept direction: Design an ingenious compact symbol using three broad rounded-square playing tiles to form a clearly readable capital L, plus one small amber tile as a single accent. The L silhouette and open negative space must remain very clear at favicon size. Pair it with a bespoke softly rounded geometric sans-serif Ludora wordmark, confident and friendly.
